card.name: Dose-adjustment wording and drug names
card.fires_on: The word "adjustments" right after "Dose", and the middle of a drug name (GAZYVA, tadalafil, saxagliptin, quetiapine) when it is repeated in dosing instructions.

modes.label: Dose adjustments
modes.description: The word "adjustments" after "Dose" in interaction advice.
modes.example: Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A inducers. Dose<< adjustments>> may be recommended.

modes.label: Inside a repeated drug name
modes.description: Middle of a drug name that was already mentioned, in dosing or titration instructions.
modes.example: Refer to the quetiapine prescribing information for initial dosing and titration of qu<<eti>>apine.

card.plain: It fires on the word "adjustments" after "Dose" and inside drug names being named again in dosing instructions.
